name: shared-theme-registry-load
body:
The per-layer theme-registry load is defined once and used by `kalide start` (internal/cli/start.go, the loader also used by `kalide check` and `kalide render`), the server's reload pipeline (internal/server/reload.go, called by Reloader.loadLibrary) and `kalide upgrade`'s post-refresh validation (internal/scaffold/upgrade.go, scaffold.validateUpgradedDeck). It loads every layer of a deck's merged template library: for a single-layer library it calls theme.LoadDir on that layer's `themes/` directory and keeps theme.LoadDir's error when `themes/` is missing; for a multi-layer library it loads each layer's `themes/` from that layer's own RootPath and merges the layers into one theme.Registry, so a theme a layer contributes keeps that layer's own files and a layer whose `themes/` is absent contributes no themes. template.LoadDeckLibrary enforces theme-name uniqueness across layers before the load, so the merge never collides and no theme silently overrides another.

AC: `kalide start`, the reload pipeline and `kalide upgrade`'s validation all call one shared loader; a two-layer deck whose theme lives in one layer resolves it, and a single-root library's missing-`themes/` error is reported exactly as theme.LoadDir reports it.
